gitCommit.subject: ci: run DB tests only when DB-relevant files change (#386)
gitCommit.body:
ci: run DB tests only when DB-relevant files change (#386)

* ci: run DB tests only when DB-relevant files change

Gate the db-tests job on paths in .github/db-test-paths.json. Run it
on every push to main. Add npm run test:db:changed for local runs and
the adored-pre-pr workflow. Add a test that fails when the DB suite
loads a file outside the list. Remove the unused code filter.

Closes purses-z4ii.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01M9e6kZgVnq963dQEsp1zdK

* ci: lint only Markdown for docs and config changes

Skip eslint, unit tests and build in CI and pre-push when every
changed file is docs, agent config or git config. List the paths in
.github/code-paths.json. Run markdownlint-cli2 with broken-Markdown
rules on every change. Pin katex and smol-toml to patched versions.

Closes purses-ihod.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01M9e6kZgVnq963dQEsp1zdK
